title: Who’s in the passenger seat?
description: Anthropic begins trading on Nasdaq amid questions about its governance. Google builds a closed network to test Chrome agents, Gemini gains computer use on the Mac, and US school districts press Google about disabling AI separately from Search.

anthropic-nasdaq-debut.verification_scope: The Verge and WIRED on pricing, trading, governance, financing commitments and local opposition to a data center.

chrome-mirror-dimension.verification_scope: WIRED’s report on the closed testing environment, its purpose and Google’s plans for internal access.

gemini-mac-computer-use.verification_scope: The Verge on app permissions, live preview, language and geographic availability.

schools-google-search-ai.verification_scope: The Verge’s reporting on school districts, public officials and Google’s response.

canva-ai-off-switch.verification_scope: The Verge on included features, exclusions, library preferences and eligibility.

chatgpt-live-dictation.verification_scope: The Verge on live transcription, the recording limit, platforms and plans.

google-homepage-ai-threads.verification_scope: The Verge on the sidebar, Robby Stein’s account of testing and the rollout.

gemini-api-tool-retrieval.verification_scope: Google developer post on deferred loading, supported models and preview status.

polly-voice-cloning.verification_scope: AWS announcement on access, consent, languages, encryption, permissions and pricing.

meta-muse-charm-price.verification_scope: The Verge citing The Information. Meta has not announced an official price.

babysitting-agents-delegation-failures.verification_scope: Full preprint, including sections 3, 4.1.4, 4.2 and 6.3 and Figure 4, on the corpus, interviews, comparisons and limitations.

discourse-amodei-cbs-regulation.date_note: CBS conversation from September, cataloged September 15
discourse-amodei-cbs-regulation.verification_scope: Editorial paraphrase of the auto-captioned CBS interview segment. No direct quotation or original-audio review.

discourse-weinstein-computer-use-trust.verification_scope: Concourse’s paraphrase of automated captions at 00:01:37–00:02:45. Percentages are illustrative.

cloudflare-clairic-open-weights.verification_scope: Cloudflare’s announcement and Hugging Face license fields. Benchmark comparisons come from internal tests.
